" hidden></iframe></section>
<section class="screen" id="screen-todo" hidden><div class="screen-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">HOVER · TO DO</p><h1>A little forward motion.</h1></div><span id="task-count"></span></div><form id="task-form" class="inline-form"><input id="task-input" placeholder="Add a task, or an action Synthia can run…" required><button class="primary">Add task</button></form><div id="task-list" class="task-list"></div><p class="fineprint">Run passes the task to local Synthia. A response is marked “review”; a completed supported action is marked “complete”.</p></section>
<section class="screen" id="screen-build" hidden><div class="screen-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">HOVER · BUILD</p><h1>Make it. Run it.</h1></div><button id="build-starter">New HTML app</button></div><div class="build-grid"><div><label>App file name<input id="build-name" value="my-app.html"></label><label>HTML<textarea id="build-source" spellcheck="false" rows="18" placeholder="Paste your HTML app here…"></textarea></label><div class="toolbar"><button id="build-run" class="primary">Run app</button><button id="build-install">Save & Install</button></div><p id="build-result" role="status"></p></div><iframe id="build-preview" title="App preview" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-downloads"></iframe></div></section>
<section class="screen" id="screen-browser" hidden><div class="screen-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">HOVER · BROWSER & HANDS</p><h1>Reach beyond the desktop.</h1></div></div><form id="browser-form" class="inline-form"><input id="browser-url" type="text" placeholder="https://example.com" required><button class="primary">Open page</button></form><p>Web pages open in your browser. Synthia can act inside this desktop; the Hover Android bridge adds device actions.</p><div class="hands-panel"><h2>Device hands</h2><p id="device-status">Android hands: not connected</p><button data-open="settings">Connect device hands</button><label>Device command<input id="device-command" placeholder="inspect screen, scroll down, tap 100 200…"></label><button id="device-run" class="primary">Run on device</button><div id="device-result" class="readable-result" role="status"></div></div><div class="hands-panel"><h2>Local hands</h2><p>Open screens, read and write workspace files, and use desktop controls through the mounted swarm.</p><button id="inspect-desktop">Inspect desktop</button><p id="inspect-result" role="status"></p></div></section>
<section class="screen" id="screen-settings" hidden><div class="screen-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME</p><h1>Settings</h1></div></div><div class="settings-grid"><article><h2>Your computer</h2><p><b>Synthia Computer Desktop 1.0</b></p><p>Local foundation, a desktop adapter for Solo Hover 0.5.8, and the preserved Agentic Reality world.</p><p id="storage-status"></p><button id="backup">Download backup</button><button id="restore-open">Restore backup</button><input id="restore-input" type="file" accept=".json" hidden><p id="backup-result" role="status"></p></article><article><h2>Hover Android hands</h2><label>Local bridge address<input id="android-url" value="http://127.0.0.1:8787"></label><button id="android-connect">Check connection</button><p id="android-status" role="status">Uses the 0.5.8 Android hand adapter. The Hover accessibility bridge must be running on the tablet.</p></article><article><h2>Appearance</h2><label>Desktop atmosphere<select id="theme"><option value="aurora">Aurora</option><option value="plum">Plum night</option><option value="midnight">Midnight blue</option></select></label><button id="toggle-hover">Show / hide Synthia hover</button></article><article><h2>Activity</h2><div id="activity-list" class="activity-list"></div><details><summary>Developer details</summary><p>Raw execution receipts are kept here for inspection.</p><pre id="developer-details"></pre></details></article></div></section>
<section class="screen" id="screen-installed" hidden><iframe id="installed-frame" title="Installed app" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-downloads"></iframe><p id="installed-result" class="readable-result" role="status"></p></section>
</div></section>
